description: MiniMax sync speech synthesis (speech-2.8-hd) via POST /v1/t2a_v2. Set the route provider model name to speech-2.8-hd. Use minimax-tts for OpenAI /v1/audio/speech, or MiniMax audio.speech passthrough for the native endpoint. Billed per upstream usage_characters.

i18n.en: MiniMax sync speech synthesis (speech-2.8-hd) via POST /v1/t2a_v2. Set the route provider model name to speech-2.8-hd. Use minimax-tts for OpenAI /v1/audio/speech, or MiniMax audio.speech passthrough for the native endpoint. Billed per upstream usage_characters.
i18n.zh: MiniMax 同步语音合成（speech-2.8-hd），走 POST /v1/t2a_v2。供应商模型名填 speech-2.8-hd。OpenAI /v1/audio/speech 用适配器 minimax-tts，原生端点用 audio.speech 透传。按上游 usage_characters 计费。
i18n.ja: MiniMax の同期音声合成（speech-2.8-hd）で、POST /v1/t2a_v2 を使います。プロバイダーモデル名は speech-2.8-hd です。OpenAI /v1/audio/speech はアダプター minimax-tts、ネイティブは audio.speech のパススルーです。上流の usage_characters で課金します。
i18n.ko: MiniMax 동기 음성 합성(speech-2.8-hd)으로, POST /v1/t2a_v2를 씁니다. 공급자 모델명은 speech-2.8-hd입니다. OpenAI /v1/audio/speech는 어댑터 minimax-tts, 네이티브는 audio.speech 패스스루입니다. 업스트림 usage_characters로 과금합니다.
